subject: words
title: Tricky words 5
about: The everyday tricky words from CKLA Units 5, 6 and 7: how, stagecoach and picture (Unit 5), cow (Unit 6) and talk (Unit 7), plus 5 phrases that use them. Unit 7's other five tricky words (Mexico, Hidalgo, Carlos, Gomez, gracias) are names and a Spanish word from its reader, so they are left out.
tip: For talk, show him the quiet l and say the word slowly: tawk.

cards.note: ow says ou as in out
oa says long o (oa is not taught until Unit 7); the a says its name and ge says j
ow says ou as in out
a says aw and the l makes no sound: tawk
three tricky words: how, are, you
